name: board-card
title: Board Card
description: A work item as a board card — a round completion tick, a two-line title, a muted context line, and a bottom row with the due chip (destructive when overdue, warning when due today), the priority chip, a source icon and the assignee's avatar.

meta.whenToUse: The content of a Board card (tasks, deals, tickets) — DataList's board view renders one per row — or a standalone work-item card.
meta.whenNotToUse: A record with an image (MediaCard), a long body (Card), or a table row (DataList).
